sloka: जवेन महता युक्तो मारुतिर्मारुतो यथा।जगाम हरिशार्दूलो दिशः शब्देन पूरयन् ।। ६.७४.५५ ।।
transliteration: javena mahatā yukto mārutirmāruto yathā।jagāma hariśārdūlo diśaḥ śabdena pūrayan ।। 6.74.55 ।।

translations.english: Going at wind speed, the great monkey Maruthi, remembering Jambavantha's words, reached and sighted the Himalayas.
